selection_rule: Three distinct Umbra SICD acquisitions; choose each new 1024x1024 ROI from original noisy complex-intensity previews only, before inspecting new method outputs. Prefer fewer extreme point-scatterer sidelobes while retaining visible urban/industrial structure.
science_input: Original provider SICD complex64 ROI; all seven methods must be rerun. Ground-proportion reprojection is for display only.
common_screening_metric: Fraction of total uncalibrated linear intensity contributed by the brightest 105 of 1048576 noisy pixels (approximately top 0.01%); descriptive star/bright-scatterer concentration only.

scenes.screening_observation: Buildings and road edges remain visible; original-complex-image pixels above the same uncalibrated 35 dB threshold fall from 2629 to 141.
Factory roof and terrain remain legible; uncalibrated original-complex-image pixels above 25 dB fall from 0.00629 to 0.00059 of the ROI.
Main road and adjacent block grid remain visible; the common brightest-105-pixel intensity share falls from 18.84% to 9.05%.

screening_metric_limit: Thresholds are uncalibrated source-pixel screening statistics only; they are not denoising quality metrics or comparable radiometry across scenes.
